exposure: Attempted vaginal delivery (yes vs. no) in monochorionic pregnancies at or after 34 weeks
Monochorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies at or after 34 weeks of gestation
outcome: Mode of delivery (Cesarean section vs Vaginal)
cohort: 1,121 women with diamniotic twin pregnancies (202 monochorionic and 919 dichorionic)
finding: Monochorionic-diamniotic pregnancies are not at an increased risk of cesarean delivery when compared with dichorionic-diamniotic counterparts.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not differ between monochorionic and dichorionic pregnancies.
